description: Two independent channels, each adding an offset to a voltage and multiplying the result

params.text: Multiplies the voltage on that channel after the offset has been added, -10 to 10
Adds -10V to 10V to the voltage on that channel before it is multiplied

inputs.text: Replaces that channel's scale knob while patched, the voltage here used as the multiplier
Replaces that channel's offset knob while patched, the voltage here added to the input
The voltage that channel works on

outputs.text: Carries the channel's input with its offset added and the result multiplied by its scale

notes: a cable at an offset or scale jack takes the place of its knob rather than being added to it, so the knob stops doing anything while the cable is in
